decision_reason: Passes all 16 (fusion is numerically correct, incl. all canaries) but REGRESSES hard: geomean 0.8696x vs c003 1.5012x, and below 1.0 (slower than reference) on 14/16 workloads. Root cause: fusing conv into the out_proj prologue recomputes the conv+gating once per output-channel tile (num_pid_n = H/BLOCK_N = 8-16 times), and those redundant memory-bound bx tap loads + cg loads far outweigh the single y round-trip saved. Worst on ragged b662596d (0.67x). Confirms the y round-trip was NOT the bottleneck; Option B is the wrong fusion for this shape. Keep c003 (1.5012x) as working best; abandon the Option B branch.
